residuals: Owner permissions do not defeat hostile same-UID modification; candidate identity is not a signature.
Existing MAX environment library closure is referenced, not copied or fully hashed.
Source-to-build correspondence and startup/recovery evidence remain separate root-owned gates.
Resource-envelope operational injection is unavailable; direct disk bound is local evidence only.
No deployment, whole-system admission or human acceptance is claimed.
decision.budget: No builds, downloads, service effects or VCS mutations. Existing tools only; 120-second operation, 20-second subprocess, two BEAM schedulers per probe, 1MiB output, 128MiB file and 512MiB total bounds.
decision.rollback: Retain failed private stage evidence; do not select it or alter production. Releases are never overwritten.
acceptance: OCaml and native Mojo commands agree
Published package verifies under an empty environment plus PATH and LANG
17 bounded filesystem and direct-verifier checks pass
Actual OTP29/ERTS17 identity and exact source/package SHA256 are recorded
decision.falsifier: The verifier accepts a missing, unexpected, tampered or symlink file, or the package contains unresolved .app dependencies/modules.
decision.forecast: A finalized web closure will package successfully and altered inventory will be rejected before runtime probing; observed by local checks, without calibration claims.
counterevidence: Independently built identical versions can still differ due to compilation/source-path metadata; simple byte-merging is unsafe.
alternatives: Merge core and web build trees
Use only the final web application closure including its Cepaf dependency
decision.summary: Immutable ecology release packaging and exact inventory verification only; no runtime deployment
assumptions: User authorizes implementation, bounded delegated coding and autonomous runtime operation; external paid inference is not authorized.
decision.reviewer: Codex implementer plus bounded independent feature review; no implied system admission.

ucas.context: Required package verification is omitted before staging.
ucas.constraint: Require exact inventory, dependency and actual OTP checks.

ucas.context: Mixed BEAM versions or malformed manifests are accepted as coherent.
ucas.constraint: Use one build closure; reject changed, missing, unexpected and unsupported entries.

ucas.context: Source changes during copy or runtime dependency bytes change after observation.
ucas.constraint: Compare source snapshots around copy and recheck hashes at invocation.

ucas.context: Packaging outlives the task lease or consumes unbounded IO/process time.
ucas.constraint: Keep Sa-plan ownership current; 120-second operation, 20-second/1MiB subprocess, 128MiB file and 512MiB total bounds.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Create and verify a source-bound immutable release candidate

fmea_modes.controls: One final web closure, exact byte inventories, source before/after hashes, actual OTP/ERTS, direct negative cases, current Sa-plan task, and no deployment effects.
fmea_modes.effect: A candidate appears verified while executing incompatible or tampered artifacts.
fmea_modes.cause: Packaging moving sources or independently compiled dependency versions can bind inconsistent BEAM files.

criticality.rationale: A coherent immutable package is required before the requested ecology can be staged.

stpa.rationale: Mutable or mismatched artifacts can execute under a misleading candidate identity.

fmea.rationale: S4 O3 Det3 RPN36 band4: source/artifact drift may deploy incorrect behavior or false evidence.

dependency.rationale: Parent runtime startup requires a verified artifact closure and realized dependencies.

impact.rationale: The package supplies one shared supervised ecology service.

snapshot.reference: Fresh exact scoped source snapshot; runtime observed separately.
